title: MediaForge governance prompt-catalog entry (fields load-bearing to check_dependency_graph.py)
description: Describes only the fields tools/prompts/check_dependency_graph.py actually reads from one docs/MediaForge/prompts/PROMPT_CATALOG.json record: p['id'] and p.get('depends_on', []). The real catalog record also carries track, track_slug, track_title, priority, focus, file, required_reads, source_paths, ui_refs -- none of which this contract validates, because nothing in check_dependency_graph.py reads them. additionalProperties is left true for exactly that reason: this schema is a load-bearing subset, not a full description of the human-authored record.

id.description: Canonical MediaForge prompt identity. Never an engine/provider id or database key.

depends_on.description: Optional. Read via p.get('depends_on', []) -- absent is equivalent to an empty array, not a validation error.
